# set production ran on 9/28/26 under Python 3.12.7 (.python-version).
# Railway (Nixpacks) installs this file. CI installs it with --no-deps and
# runs `pip check`, so a package missing from the lock, or a pin another
# package refuses, fails CI before it can reach a deploy.

# To change a version: edit requirements.in, then, under Python 3.12,
#   pip install pip-tools && pip-compile --output-file=requirements.txt requirements.in
# and review the diff (put this header back).
